# Load libraries and directories
```{r}
#Install missing packages
BiocManager::install("dada2")
BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
BiocManager::install("seqTools")
```

```{r}
library(dada2)
library(magrittr)
library(phyloseq)
library(fs)
library(ShortRead)
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(tools)
library(seqTools)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls()) # clear environment 

# Project-related directories: change as needed! 
dmc.dir = file.path("/data/folder/PacBio_pipeline") # CHANGE ME to parent directory
git.dir = file.path(dmc.dir, "ITS") # CHANGE ME to project directory
data.dir = file.path(dmc.dir, "ITS") # CHANGE ME to where sequencing files are stored (.fastq.gz)

# Read in metadata: Change as needed! 
meta.file = file.path(dmc.dir, "metadata_ITS.csv") # CHANGE ME to where metadata file is 
meta.df = read_csv(meta.file)

# Directories for temporary files 
scratch.dir = file.path("/output/data/temp") # CHANGE ME to project work directory
### change me to your NetID!! If you don't have a work folder already, create one by running the following codes on Terminal portion of RStudio: 
### cd /work/
### mkdir NETID          

output.dir = path.expand(file.path(scratch.dir, paste0("output")))

### Note: you only need to make your work directory ONCE! Don't run this if already have the folders setup, it will erase any previous settings.
if (dir_exists(scratch.dir)) {
  dir_delete(scratch.dir)
}
dir_create(scratch.dir)

if (dir_exists(output.dir)) {
  dir_delete(output.dir)
}
dir_create(output.dir)

noprimers.dir = path.expand(file.path(scratch.dir,paste0("noprimers")))
### Note: you only need to make your work directory ONCE! Don't run this if already have the folders setup, it will erase any previous settings.
dir_create(noprimers.dir)

filt.dir = path.expand(file.path(scratch.dir,paste0("filt")))
### Note: you only need to make your work directory ONCE! Don't run this if already have the folders setup, it will erase any previous settings.
dir_create(filt.dir)

# Bash shortcuts
Sys.setenv(SCRATCH_DIR = scratch.dir)
Sys.setenv(OUT_DIR = output.dir)
Sys.setenv(DATA_DIR = data.dir)
Sys.setenv(FILT_DIR = filt.dir)
Sys.setenv(NOPRIMERS_DIR = noprimers.dir)

# Ref database
### Unite database: 2/19/25, all eukaryotes downloaded from https://doi.plutof.ut.ee/doi/10.15156/BIO/3301231
### see https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/training.html for Dr. Callhan's recommendation for this database

database.dir = file.path("/data/folder/Reference") # CHANGE ME to database folder 
unite.ref = path.expand(file.path(database.dir, paste0("sh_general_release_dynamic_all_19.02.2025_dev.fasta")))
```

```{r}
old <- Sys.time() # get start time
```

## Check that metadata and file names match
```{r}
meta.df %>% arrange(Primer_ID) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = str_extract(Sample_Name, ".*(?=\\_)")) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% dplyr::count(group)
```

```{r}
meta.df %>% 
  mutate(group = str_extract(Sample_Name, ".*(?=\\_)"),
         group = replace_na(group, "PCRneg"),
         Primer_ID = str_replace_all(Primer_ID, "ITS", "16S")) -> meta.full

meta.full
```

```{r}
fns <- sort(list.files(data.dir, pattern=".hifi_reads.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE)) # forward reads
head(fns)
```

```{r}
sample.names <- unlist(meta.full$Primer_ID)
length(sample.names)
length(meta.full$Primer_ID)

any((meta.full$Primer_ID %in% sample.names)==FALSE) # are there any sample names in metadata file that are not present in the sample names extracted from fastq files? 

meta.full$Primer_ID %in% sample.names
```

#Remove primers and orient reads
```{r}
ITS1catta <- "ACCWGCGGARGGATCATTA"
ITS4ngsUni <- "CCTSCSCTTANTDATATGC"

nops <- file.path(noprimers.dir, "noprimers", basename(fns))
primers_removed <- removePrimers(fns, nops, primer.fwd=ITS1catta, primer.rev=dada2:::rc(ITS4ngsUni), orient=TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
```


```{r}
primers_removed %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(percent_filtered = (reads.in - reads.out) / reads.in * 100)
```



#Filter & Trim
```{r}
filts <- file.path(filt.dir, "noprimers", "filtered", sample.names)
track <- filterAndTrim(nops, filts, minQ=3, minLen=250, maxLen=1200, maxN=0, rm.phix=FALSE, maxEE=3) # compare to maxEE = 2 (previously run)
```

```{r}
track %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(percent_filtered = (reads.in - reads.out) / reads.in * 100) -> track.df

track.df
```

```{r}
track.df %>% summary()
```

```{r}
lens.fn <- lapply(filts, function(fn) nchar(getSequences(fn)))
lens <- do.call(c, lens.fn)
hist(lens, 50)
```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(filts[1:130], aggregate = T) -> p.q3

p.q3 + labs(title = "After filtering & trimming")
```

#Dereplicate
```{r}
dereps <- derepFastq(filts, verbose=TRUE)
```

#Error correction
###For PacBio, Ben seems to be doing dereplicating then error correcting.
```{r}
err <- learnErrors(filts, errorEstimationFunction=PacBioErrfun,  multithread=TRUE) 
```

```{r}
plotErrors(err, nominalQ=TRUE)
```

#DADA2
```{r}
dadas <- dada(dereps, err=err, multithread=TRUE)
```

#QC: Sequence length
```{r}
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(dadas)
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
```

###Since this table can be hard to read when long, let’s turn this into a dataframe and graph this instead.
```{r}
nchar(getSequences(seqtab)) %>% as_tibble() -> amplicon.df

# This is number of ASVs of this length 
read_length_distribution <- ggplot(amplicon.df, aes(x=value)) + theme_bw()+ 
 geom_histogram(binwidth=1) + 
 labs(title = "ASV Length Distribution", x = "ASV Length (bp)", y = "Frequency")

read_length_distribution
```

#Chimera Removal
```{r}
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method="consensus", minFoldParentOverAbundance = 3.5, multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)

dim(seqtab.nochim)

sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab) * 100
```

#Track reads through pipeline
```{r}
track.df
```

```{r}
cbind(ccs=primers_removed[,1], primers=primers_removed[,2], filtered=track.df[,2], denoised=sapply(dadas, function(x) sum(x$denoised)), nonchim = rowSums(seqtab.nochim)) -> reads.df

reads.df
```

```{r}
reads.df %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Primer_ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = c(ccs:nonchim), 
  names_to = "stage",
  values_to = "counts"
)  %>%  mutate(stage=factor(stage, levels = c('ccs','primers','filtered','denoised','nonchim'))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(counts = as.numeric(counts)) -> track.graph

track.graph %>%
  left_join(meta.full, by = "Primer_ID") %>% 
    ggplot(mapping=aes(x=stage, y=counts, by=Primer_ID, group = Primer_ID, color = group)) +
    geom_line(alpha=0.5) + 
    theme_classic() +labs(x = "DADA2 Stage", y = "Number of Reads")
```

#Assign taxonomy
For plotting purposes, having ASV numbers (ex. ASV1-ASV999) is easier, but it’s also useful to have the whole DNA sequences as the RefSeq object.
##UNITE database
```{r}
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, unite.ref, multithread=TRUE)
```

```{r}
taxa.print <- taxa # Removing sequence rownames for display only
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL
head(taxa.print)
```

```{r}
taxa.print %>% as.data.frame() -> taxa.df
taxa.df %>% filter(is.na(Species) == FALSE) %>% nrow() -> n.species
taxa.df %>% filter(is.na(Genus) == FALSE) %>% nrow() -> n.genus
taxa.df %>% nrow() -> n.taxa

n.species / n.taxa * 100

n.genus / n.taxa * 100

n.species / n.genus * 100
```

```{r}
meta.full %>% column_to_rownames("Primer_ID") -> meta.ps.df # Change SeqName into rownames for passing off to phyloseq
meta.ps.df %>% head()

rownames(seqtab.nochim)
```

```{r}
all(rownames(seqtab.nochim) %in% rownames(meta.ps.df))
```

#Save and export as phyloseq object
```{r}
otus = otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows=FALSE)
sd = sample_data(meta.ps.df)
ps <- phyloseq(otus,
               sd,
               tax_table(taxa))
```

```{r}
# Extract DNA sequences and add them as reference sequences 
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(ps)
ps@refseq <- dna
ps

# Extract refseq.fasta to use QIIME2 sklearn taxonomy classifier
writeXStringSet(dna, filepath = "PacBio/pacbio_refseq.fasta", format = "fasta")
```

```{r}
# Give ASVs numbers which are easier for graphing & analyzing than the full sequence 
taxa_names(ps) <- paste0("ASV", seq(ntaxa(ps)))  
ps
```

```{r}
# Export final phyloseq object and check that it was written and saved correctly 
ps.rds = file.path(git.dir, paste0("ITS_UNITE.rds"))
saveRDS(ps, ps.rds)
loaded.ps = read_rds(ps.rds)
print(loaded.ps)
```

```{r}
new <- Sys.time() - old # calculate difference
print(new) # print in nice format
```
